# Amazon (5 endpoints)

## Endpoints

| Resource | Params | Credits | Description |
|----------|--------|---------|-------------|
| /shop | `url` | 1 | Get Amazon shop page |
| /product-search | `query` | 1 | Search Amazon products by keyword |
| /product | `asin` | 5 | Get an Amazon product by ASIN |
| /reviews | `asin` | 5 | Get Amazon product reviews |
| /sellers | `asin` | 1 | Get Amazon sellers and offers for a product |

### Parameter legend

- `a`, `b` — both required.
- `a` / `b` — a `oneOf` group: at least one member must be provided.
- `a`? — the spec marks nothing required, but these are the parameters the endpoint accepts;
  a bare call usually will not work. See Endpoint Details for which combination to send.
- *(none)* — takes no parameters at all.
- A method prefix (**POST**, **DELETE**, **PATCH**) marks a non-GET endpoint; unmarked rows are GET.
- Every endpoint also accepts the `Cache-Control` header (send `no-cache` to bypass the
  response cache — billed at the normal rate) and `Idempotency-Key` (a UUID that makes a
  retry safe; a replay returns the cached payload without double-billing).

## Endpoint Details

_What each endpoint returns and when to reach for it._

### /shop — 1cr

Returns product listings from an Amazon shop or storefront page including product names, prices, ratings, and images.

**Parameters**

- `url`: Full URL of the Amazon shop or storefront page

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/amazon/shop?url=<url>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /product-search — 1cr

Returns organic Amazon search results for a keyword — title, price, list price, rating, image, and ASIN per product. Results reflect the chosen marketplace (default United States). Sponsored placements and related searches are excluded in v1. Paginate with the universal cursor parameter; pass depth instead if you need a single large page.

**Parameters**

- `query`: Search keyword or phrase.
- `country` *(optional)*: Amazon marketplace as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (default US). Supported: US, GB, CA, DE, FR, IT, ES, JP, IN, MX, BR, AU, NL. Non-US marketplaces are best-effort; an occasional timeout is refunded.
- `depth` *(optional)*: Maximum number of products to return in ONE call (default 20, max 700). Use it when you would rather make a single large request than paginate: it selects a different, slower search backend whose latency grows with depth, and a timeout is auto-refunded. Leave it unset for the fast default page size, which is the better choice for keyword→ASIN resolution.
- `page` *(optional)*: Page number, starting at 1. Prefer the universal cursor parameter. Native upstream cursor param. Send the universal `cursor` instead — the API maps it to this name for you.
- `cursor` *(optional)*: Universal pagination cursor. Send `pagination.next_cursor` from the previous response back verbatim — the API maps it to this endpoint's native `page` (page style). You never construct, decode, or look up a cursor. Omit it for page 1.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/amazon/product-search?query=<query>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /product — 5cr

Returns full product detail for an Amazon ASIN — title, brand, description, price, rating, image gallery, specifications, and variant ASINs. Powered by DataForSEO. For this product's customer reviews, call GET /v1/amazon/reviews with the same ASIN (shared upstream call).

**Parameters**

- `asin`: 10-character Amazon ASIN (the product identifier).
- `country` *(optional)*: Amazon marketplace as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (default US). Supported: US, GB, CA, DE, FR, IT, ES, JP, IN, MX, BR, AU, NL. Note: non-US marketplaces (especially EU) are best-effort — the upstream provider is slower and occasionally times out for these; such calls are refunded, and US is the most reliable marketplace.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/amazon/product?asin=<asin>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /reviews — 5cr

Returns the customer reviews shown on an Amazon product page (by ASIN), typically around 8 per product (5–13 range). Each review carries the full text, star rating, reviewer, verified-purchase flag, helpful-vote count, and any review images. Works on the US marketplace, which is the default; no workaround parameter is needed. A product with no on-page reviews returns a refunded empty list.

**Parameters**

- `asin`: 10-character Amazon ASIN (the product identifier).
- `country` *(optional)*: Amazon marketplace as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (default US). Supported: US, GB, CA, DE, FR, IT, ES, JP, IN, MX, BR, AU, NL. Amazon shows reviews across a product's whole variant family, so a review row can originate from a sibling ASIN; review.entity_id is always the ASIN you requested.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/amazon/reviews?asin=<asin>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /sellers — 1cr

Returns every seller offering a given Amazon ASIN — seller name, price, rating, and condition (new / used / refurbished), including the buy-box winner. Powered by DataForSEO.

**Parameters**

- `asin`: 10-character Amazon ASIN (the product identifier).
- `country` *(optional)*: Amazon marketplace as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (default US). Supported: US, GB, CA, DE, FR, IT, ES, JP, IN, MX, BR, AU, NL. Note: non-US marketplaces (especially EU) are best-effort — the upstream provider is slower and occasionally times out for these; such calls are refunded, and US is the most reliable marketplace.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/amazon/sellers?asin=<asin>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```


## Choosing an Amazon endpoint

| Your goal | Use this | Credits |
|-----------|----------|---------|
| Find products for a keyword | `/product-search` | 1 |
| One product's full detail (by ASIN) | `/product` | 5 |
| What buyers actually say | `/reviews` | 5 |
| Who else sells this, and at what price | `/sellers` | 1 |
| A creator's Amazon storefront | `/shop` | 1 |

### The 1cr / 5cr split is the whole decision

`/product-search` and `/sellers` are 1cr; `/product` and `/reviews` are 5cr. If a search
result already carries the title, price and rating you needed, stop there — you do not need
`/product`. Reach for `/product` (5cr) only when you need the full listing for a specific
ASIN, and `/reviews` (5cr) only when you need review *text*.

`/shop` (1cr) reads a creator's Amazon storefront page — useful for mapping what a creator
actually promotes, which is a monetization signal rather than a commerce one.

### Cross-marketplace questions

For a product's reputation across marketplaces, `prism/product-reviews` (30cr) folds Amazon +
Google Shopping + Trustpilot into one rating with themed pros and cons. Two 5cr Amazon calls
answer an Amazon-only question; the 30cr call answers "is this product well regarded
anywhere".
